summary: VDD execution-plan skill; route standalone requirements to direct implementation, explicit complete-directory create/repair only; select standard/resumable/self-hosted before model routing; mandatory authority, clarification, lifecycle, knowledge, and skill-input gates; lifecycle draft→plan-ready→implementation-authorized→implementation-complete→acceptance-passed→archived; slices require behavior, failure intent, acceptance target, dependents, recovery; VDD does not own RED execution; repair is in-place under repair/round-n, immutable history, bounded lineage budget; current hash-bound scope/manifests and composition receipts required; knowledge preflight and typed semantic child required before plan artifacts; terminal full validation required before implementation-complete; reports/index required for resumable/self-hosted; Bootstrap optional and non-authorizing; P2-only findings do not trigger semantic repair round; no multi-writer/adversarial controls by default; generic package must exclude live paths, hashes, identities, machine paths
